acceptedAnswer.text: If you live in Denver, Centennial, Greenwood Village, Foxfield, or Parker, local service matters because availability, travel time, and inspection timing can affect the schedule. It also helps to choose a contractor familiar with Colorado homes, where older bathrooms may have hidden moisture issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: A local contractor usually means faster scheduling, easier communication, and better handling of common regional bathroom issues.
